text: A hanging decoration of reed and copper for porches and doorways. It spends no Pulse and has no job; it is there to look nice.

pages.title: Hanging it
text: Place it against the underside of a sturdy ceiling. It hangs in the space below.
You can walk straight through it: it has no collision.
Break the block above it and it pops off.
Redstone does nothing to it. It is not a Pulse light, and not a Wind Harp.
